questions.subject: chemistry
questions.content:
Statement 1 : Micelles are formed by surfactant molecules above the critical micellar concentration (CMC).

Statement 2 : The conductivity of a solution having surfactant molecules decreases sharply at the CMC.

options.content: Statement 1 is True, Statement 2 is True, Statement 2 is a CORRECT explanation for Statement 1
Statement 1 is True, Statement 2 is True, Statement 2 is NOT a CORRECT explanation for Statement 1
Statement 1 is True, Statement 2 is False
Statement 1 is False, Statement 2 is True

questions.explanation: In colloidal surfactants, critical micelle concentration (CMC) is the concentration of surfactants above which micelles. Once micelles are formed, the polar surfactants are not free to conduct electricity. Also, a micelle is much larger than a monomer it diffuses more slowly through solution and so is a less efficient charge carrier.
